arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
from parse import compile, Parser

# Test cases that should raise errors
test_cases_should_fail = [
    '{world',           # unclosed field
    'hello {',          # trailing open brace
    '} hello',          # leading close brace
    '{',                # just open brace
    '}',                # just close brace
    '{{{',              # {{ followed by unmatched {
    '{foo}}',           # valid field followed by unmatched }
    'hel{lo',           # brace in middle of text
]

print('Testing cases that SHOULD fail:')
for tc in test_cases_should_fail:
    try:
        p = compile(tc)
        print(f'  {tc!r:20} -> ERROR: Should have raised exception but got expression {p._expression!r}')
    except ValueError as e:
        print(f'  {tc!r:20} -> OK: Raised ValueError: {e}')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'  {tc!r:20} -> UNEXPECTED: {type(e).__name__}: {e}')

print()

# Test cases that should work
test_cases_should_pass = [
    '{}',               # simple field
    '{name}',           # named field  
    '{{ }}',            # escaped braces
    '{a.b}',            # dotted name
    '{a[0]}',           # indexed access
    'Hello {name}',     # text + field
    '{{',               # escaped open
    '}}',               # escaped close
    'hel{lo}',          # balanced braces in text (escaped?)
    'no braces here',   # plain text
    '{{{{',             # two escaped opens
    '}}}}',             # two escaped closes
    '{{ a }}',          # escaped braces with space
]

print('Testing cases that SHOULD pass:')
for tc in test_cases_should_pass:
    try:
        p = compile(tc)
        print(f'  {tc!r:25} -> OK: expression={p._expression!r}')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'  {tc!r:25} -> ERROR: {type(e).__name__}: {e}')
"
